thread:
marta_ops: FYI we just got a schedule change from BlueRiver — partial H100 allocation slipped into Jun 14-17 (split shipment). This will pinch eu-west Dedicated pools if we don't fill the hole.
liam_sourcing: Ugh. What fraction moved?
marta_ops: ~28 units of the 120 we expected for June. They offered to split: 28 by air (earlier but higher cost) or keep sea (delayed).
liam_sourcing: Price delta?
sam_vendor: BlueRiver here — air adds $850/unit freight+brokerage vs sea. We can also do a staggered RMA-safe label for crossdock to avoid customs hold (adds ~$40/unit paperwork).
devin_logistics: If we take the air, forwarder ETA is 48-72h to FRA hub, then 24h depot. Customs risk still exists but reduced. Sea ETA pushes into late July; that kills Q2 commit for eu-dedicated.
jules_infra: Cluster impact: losing 28 H100s for June means ~12% throughput drop for eu-west batch workloads. We'll need to throttle low-priority jobs and re-route latency-sensitive traffic to other regions. That increases egress and cross-region costs.
liam_sourcing: Run the math and compare: air premium vs cost of throttling + cross-region ops. Can someone ballpark the ops+cost impact?
jules_infra: Quick calc: cross-region reroute + preemption/fallback increases monthly spend ~ $65k if sustained. SLA risk for one large customer too.
liam_sourcing: So air looks cheaper if ops impact > $850*28 = $23.8k? But there's also brokerage + spool of insurance.
marta_ops: Also BlueRiver flagged potential serial mismatch risk on split shipments — they'd include temp serials and swap later. That triggers RMA flow.
devin_logistics: RMA flow is annoying — crossdock swap requires depot photos, manifests, and a short-term serial escrow. That has ~3-5 day turnaround for processing and increases docking labor.
sam_vendor: We can pre-sign a conditional replacement SLA: BlueRiver ships air with temp IDs and we get a bill-of-exchange to swap serials on depot arrival. We'll handle pre-auth paperwork.
liam_sourcing: OK what about customs classification? EU HS codes were the previous pain point. If we air, brokerage team says paperwork must include model-level HS and invoice value or customs may hold.
devin_logistics: Correct. Also need to prebook the courier's brokerage queue to avoid a late-night hold. I can start booking if we greenlight air.
marta_ops: rma_bot created ticket RMA-4521 for the temp-serial swap when Sam mentioned escrow (auto).
rma_bot: [system] Ticket RMA-4521 created — workflow: temp-serial intake -> photo evidence -> manifest reconcile -> final-serial issuance. Expected cycle: 3 business days.
liam_sourcing: Two asks before I approve air: 1) vendor confirms AWB and proforma with HS codes; 2) infra confirms fallback plan for remaining capacity.
sam_vendor: I'll upload AWB and proforma in 30m. HS codes included. We can also absorb $12/unit brokerage fee if that helps.
jules_infra: Fallback plan: can shift 6 of our eu batch nodes to us-east for econ window (will bump cross-region traffic + risk). We'll shed 40% low-priority batch; latency-critical stays in eu but at reduced QPS. Ops impact estimate revised to ~$48k for the month if we delay air.
liam_sourcing: With brokerage absorbed and faster ETA, air + RMA looks favorable. Approve conditional air if vendor covers $12/unit brokerage and provides AWB+HS now.
sam_vendor: Confirmed. I'll DM the AWB number and upload docs. AWB: 123-BRV-5567.
devin_logistics: Noted AWB 123-BRV-5567. Forwarder ETA 48-72h into FRA. Initiating courier prebook.
marta_ops: Action items: Sam upload docs (on it), Devin prebook forwarder, Jules publish throttling plan & traffic reroute TTL, Liam sign off on PO amendment for air freight.
liam_sourcing: Signed off contingent on docs.
sam_vendor: Uploaded proforma + HS list to the shared drive. Also flagged that one unit has a minor firmware mismatch on vendor QC — will require firmware swap on depot (should be covered under DOA tolerance).
jules_infra: If firmware swap required, that adds a depot 1h per unit reflash. Add to RMA ticket notes.
devin_logistics: Also note: insurer needs serials for coverage. With temp serials, we must attach a provisional manifest to the insurance binder. I'll update RMA-4521.
rma_bot: [system] RMA-4521 updated: insurer info attached.
marta_ops: Final call: air + temp-serial + RMA process. We absorb minor overhead but save Q2 commit health. I'll finalize PO amendment. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
liam_sourcing: Thanks all. Keep thread updated with AWB scan + customs release.
devin_logistics: Will post inbound scans and depot ETA here.
sam_vendor: Will push AWB scans and photos when available.
jules_infra: Publishing a short ops playbook in the eu-dedicated channel for throttles and alerts.
marta_ops: Closing loop — will mark thread resolved once RMA ticket closes and depot confirms final serial reconciliation.
